message: 僕の仔猫ちゃん

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, let's hurry home and study for the exams. We're only halfway there--if we let our guard down now, it's over.」

name: Misa
message: 「Come now, let's get home right away and study. We've only just finished the first day; the real battle is tomorrow.」
I bump right into Misa in the hallway.

name: Synn
message: 「H-Hey...」

name: Misa
message: 「Hey you, don't follow me around.」

name: Synn
message: 「You've got the wrong idea, I'm just trying to head to the shoe lockers.」

name: Misa
message: 「Obviously I am too.」
Inevitably ending up side by side with Misa, we head toward the shoe lockers to leave school. Before I know it, our pace starts picking up.

name: Misa
message: 「I-I won't lose! I'm going to make it home first!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Gah!?」
The instant we pass the hallway, Misa bolts down the stairs, skipping three steps at a time.
Since when was Misa this athletic?

name: Paqy
message: 「Welp, she went and blew herself up.」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh no, Misa!」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa, hang in there! Here!」

name: Misa
message: 「Why... are you crouching down... with your back... turned to me...?」

name: Synn
message: 「Get on my back! I'll carry you straight to the infirmary.」

name: Misa
message: 「I can't do... something... so disgraceful!」

name: Synn
message: 「This isn't the time to be stubborn!」

name: Misa
message: 「H-How rude...! Who are you calling... obstinate!?」

name: Misa
message: 「I... j-just twisted my ankle... a tiny bit. I can walk... totally... normally, you know!」

name: Misa
message: 「Excuse... me!」

name: Synn
message: 「You can't even walk properly」

name: Misa
message: 「Ugh! I-It doesn't... hurt at all. I'm just acting... to tease you...!」

name: Misa
message: 「Hah... hah... hah...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well, just like Hiss herself says, it ain't a serious injury, right? Not even a scratch, so if she rests for two or three hours, she'll recover, yeah?」

name: Synn
message: 「Phew, thank goodness」

name: Misa
message: 「I'm the one... who's relieved...!」

name: Misa
message: 「Hah... hah... I want to go home...」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey Misa, instead of a piggyback ride, how about letting me lend you my shoulder?」

name: Misa
message: 「Hah... hah... N-No... It's not like... I'm embarrassed or anything, okay?」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm, should I go call Shio-chan instead of me, then?」

name: Misa
message: 「Stop that! Shio is working hard to place in the top 10 on this next test! I can't get in her way」

name: Misa
message: 「Our match is on hold. Sakura-kun, you go on home first. After all, I'll heal up if I just stay still for two or three hours」

name: Synn
message: 「You just said you wanted to go home, didn't you? I'm sure you want to study for the test for even a single minute longer, Misa」

name: Misa
message: 「W-What's your deal, stop nitpicking my words. First of all, do you even know where my house is?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, I don't」

name: Misa
message: 「I will NEVER, EVER tell you!!」

name: Synn
message: 「I see... Well, it can't be helped then, I got it」

name: Misa
message: 「T-That's right, as long as you understand. Honestly, you're so stubborn」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, yeah, looks like I have no choice but to use my last resort」

name: Paqy
message: 「Synn-sama? What're you planning to do grabbin' the scruff of my neck like that?」

name: Synn
message: 「Poof」
I slap Paqy onto my own face.

name: Paqy
message: 「Nwooooh!? S-Synn-sama's breath and lips are caressing my chest and belly button!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Forcing humiliation play on me out in public like this... E-Expected nothing less.」

name: Synn
message: 「Paqy, cut the jokes.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Sure thing.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey Hiss, now you don't gotta worry about Synn-sama finding out your address, right?」

name: Misa
message: 「...So I'll navigate and give Sakura-kun directions on where to go?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, though you'll have to stick close to me so I can hear you easily.」

name: Misa
message: 「Shut up, you don't have to point out every little thing!」
And so, somehow or other, I managed to see Misa all the way home... apparently.

name: Misa
message: 「Heehee. Spin, spin, spin.」

name: Synn
message: 「M-M-M-Misa? What are you doing to me!?」
At what seemed to be the entrance to her house, Misa spun me around several times while I stood there blindfolded.

name: Misa
message: 「Spin, spin, spin... Now your sense of direction is completely messed up.」

name: Synn
message: 「T-That's awful! Isn't this just like abandoning a kitten!?」

name: Misa
message: 「Paqy-san, I'll leave the rest to you. Please keep acting as an eye mask until you reach Grand Palace Sakura!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Good grief, what a pain.」
Late that night, I got a phone call from Misa.
Regarding what happened during the day, she offered the most roundabout expression of gratitude imaginable, followed by her usual declaration of war.
That the pain in her foot had completely subsided, that it wouldn't interfere with studying for the test, and that the real showdown is tomorrow.
